summary.en: Another incident, Bonzo Ono was found dead in a room, the murder weapon is a sickle. They found him at the annex, and the victim was lying down when he was dead. The reason why the balloon was popped up because of BB pellets scattered around the floor. Kazuha said that the popping of the balloons were at the same time. But the BB pellets were only three. And Conan smell something, Ran said that there are still glass shards all over the floor. The strange smell is a cleaning detergent, and then he said that it was cold because it got covered in rainwater or something. And then they heard about the head chef who was throw off, but she didn't know, she only heard about it when she was married into the family. And they solve the case without a doubt.
